depiction.primary_object: two concentric rings around a central dot
modifiers: bold exclamation mark stem breaking the top of the rings
depiction.composition: centered symmetrical glyph combining concentric waves and an exclamation point

readings.meaning: urgent alert broadcast or alarm signal

ambiguity: Can be mistaken for a power button, a bullseye target, or a location pin on a map at small sizes.

modifier_semantics.meaning: broadcasting, radiating signal, sensor range, or target
